g.text: Default: all three source shunts 2-3 PROBE; ARM jumper open. Move all three to 1-2 for XEM master operation.

g.desc: Default: all three source shunts 2-3 PROBE; ARM jumper open. Move all three to 1-2 for XEM master operation.

g.text: Target-derived VTREF supplies the translator B rail; the host never drives VTREF. The host does not supply the target reference.
